name: Nimavo Chat
author: arshiyan

sections.description:
Nimavo Chat adds the Nimavo live chat widget to your WordPress site. Connect your site with a Site Key from your Nimavo dashboard and start chatting with visitors in minutes.

This plugin is a free connector. The chat service runs on Nimavo. You need a Nimavo account to use the widget.

Features

  • Live chat widget embedded on every public page
  • Working hours and offline message support (configured in Nimavo)
  • SMS follow-up links for returning conversations (Nimavo service)
  • Per-site widget appearance overrides (color, shape, icon, animation, position)
  • Optional WooCommerce integration: identify logged-in customers and show order stats to operators (with Secret Key)

WooCommerce (optional)

If WooCommerce is active and you add a Secret Key from Nimavo, logged-in customers can be identified securely in chat. Operators may see order count and total spent alongside the conversation.

External services

This plugin connects to Nimavo (https://nimavo.ir) to provide live chat functionality.

What is sent and when:

  • Site Key — included in the widget script tag on public pages so the widget loads for your site.
  • Widget script — browsers load https://nimavo.ir/widget/v1.js and communicate with https://nimavo.ir/api/widget.
  • Visitor chat data — messages and session data submitted through the widget are processed by Nimavo (subject to Nimavo terms and privacy policy).
  • Logged-in user context (optional) — when a Secret Key is saved and a user is logged in, the plugin outputs a JSON block with: user ID, HMAC user hash, display name, email, phone (from user meta / WooCommerce billing), platform label, order count, and total spent. This helps operators recognize customers in chat.

Links:

  • Service: https://nimavo.ir
  • Terms / privacy: see https://nimavo.ir for current policies.

No data is sent to Nimavo until you configure a Site Key and publish pages with the widget.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Nimavo Chat from the WordPress plugin directory, or upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Sign up at nimavo.ir and create a site in your Nimavo dashboard.
  3. Copy your Site Key (Public Key) from Nimavo → Sites → Install widget.
  4. In WordPress go to Settings → Nimavo and paste the Site Key. Save.
  5. Visit your site front end — the chat button should appear.

Optional: add Secret Key for logged-in user / WooCommerce identification.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Nimavo account?

Yes. This plugin connects your WordPress site to the Nimavo chat service. Create a free account at nimavo.ir.

Is WooCommerce required?

No. The widget works on any WordPress site. WooCommerce features apply only when WooCommerce is installed and a Secret Key is configured.

What is the Secret Key for?

The Secret Key signs a secure context payload for logged-in users (HMAC). Without it, visitors can still chat anonymously; logged-in users are not automatically identified.

Where is widget appearance configured?

Default appearance comes from your Nimavo dashboard. Settings under Settings → Nimavo override appearance for this WordPress site only.

Does this plugin store chat messages in WordPress?

No. Messages and conversations are stored on Nimavo servers, not in your WordPress database.
